timeouts._comment: Bumped from 300s/900s after DeepSeek V4 Pro hit timeouts on larger prompts. Older agents still finish well within.

_runs_comment: PREREGISTRATION.md §6 fixes N = 10 runs per arm × scenario × agent for the confirmatory run (N ≥ 5 pilot). The March-era value of 3 had ~zero power (Holm-corrected p ≈ 1.0 across the board on 2026-07-04).
_judges_comment: All-Google judge panel (2026-07-05 second amendment): gemini-3.5-flash + gemini-2.5-pro + gemini-3.1-flash-lite — three distinct models/generations, one family. Agent under test = DeepSeek V4 Pro; no judge shares the agent's family (the axis that prevents self-preference, arXiv 2502.01534). DISCLOSED LIMITATION: judge-family monoculture — all three judges share Google lineage, so family-level judge bias is not averaged out; mitigated by (a) needle-fact rubrics that minimize judge discretion, (b) the old-panel Scenario A run retained for cross-panel robustness comparison. Chosen because: Anthropic key has no budget headroom, OPENAI_API_KEY in .env is invalid, and local Ollama judging was the campaign bottleneck. Upgrade path: valid OPENAI_API_KEY -> swap gemini_flash_lite for {provider: 'openai'}.

cloud.description: Uses each agent's default cloud API (Anthropic, Google)

ollama.description: Routes all agents through local Ollama for controlled comparison

_deferred_comment: Scenario E (continual coding, write-side memorize) is exercised separately — it is fragile and even SWE-Bench-CL reports continual-coding memory as empirically inconclusive. Run with: node harness/runner.js --scenario scenario-E-continual --agent claude.
